from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection, capturing its identity and in-collection citation targets."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cited_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in this collection that this paper cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
